rationale: First review of the accepted direct check c30f6cc0db39422ab3985999ab44c9a7 (version 1) for obligation c-reported-configuration-index. No input issue is open on this artifact, so it supplies the single required checker_correspondence item, which reviews the requirement, the encoded predicate, the fixed inputs, the binding, the oracle, the correlated observations, the legality and the counterevidence together. The reviewed execution is check 50dfd2990fc84e9386252c784e75f7c5: exit 0, completed, prerequisites matched, and the retained stdout shows the configuration established at index 1 while the configuration future reported index 0 and Stats published "0" for the same future whose returned configuration still contains the local voter.

review_items.rationale: The obligation under review says the configuration future returned by Raft.GetConfiguration must report, as its index, the log index at which the configuration it returns was established, so a caller can relate the participant set it receives to a position in the log and to the value the library publishes for the same future. The check encodes that directly. Its entry point is the accessor itself, which builds its future from the copy of the latest configuration and responds immediately, so the configuration field is current while the index field of that value is never set (s-api-get-configuration), and whose index is documented as the index of the applied log entry and published as latest_configuration_index in Stats (s-api-stats-config-index). The fixed inputs are the package's own NewRaft and BootstrapCluster on a single-voter configuration, so the configuration entry is the only entry in the log and the index at which the configuration was established is the log's last index (s-api-newraft-config, s-raft-append-config); the check uses only public accessors (GetConfiguration, Stats, LastIndex, State) and modifies no target file, and the binding bind-raft-get-configuration locates the accessor that omits the index (s-config-next shows the configuration construction that carries the index internally). The oracle compares the index the future reports with the index at which the configuration was established, and applicability requires the configuration the future returned to still contain the local voter, so a stale or empty configuration cannot be mistaken for an index defect. The prerequisite chain is complete: the admission event reports the established index and precedes the result event in the single runner stream with the same node and op identity, and the result follows a completed future. The retained observation is the violation: configuration_established with index 1 and log_last_index 1, then configuration_index_observed with reported_index 0, stats_index "0", configuration_has_self true, log_last_index 1 and node state Follower, with the test exiting 0. Counterevidence was reviewed with the inputs: the returned Configuration value itself is correct and current, so a caller that ignores the index is unaffected; the index is available inside the main goroutine, so the value is omitted from the copy the accessor uses rather than being unavailable; nothing in the accessor's documentation says the index may be unset while the same field is published as a metric (s-api-stats-config-index); and a caller cannot obtain the pair through any other public accessor. What the check does not establish is listed in limitations.
limitations: The prefix contains a single configuration entry, so the comparison cannot distinguish an index that is always wrong from one that happens to differ only for the first configuration; a second configuration change in the same prefix would be a separate scenario.
The check observes an index value rather than a state transition, so it reports what the accessor and the metric said and does not observe any downstream consequence for callers.
No in-repo or documented consumer of the value is established, so the practical consequence is inferred from the accessor's contract and the published metric rather than measured.
Only one node and one configuration are exercised, and the configuration value itself is only checked for containing the local voter, not compared field by field.
Whether the intended repair carries the index with the atomic copy or routes the accessor through the main loop remains open and is retained as an independent boundary.
review_items.report_title: 配置 future 报告的索引始终为零
review_items.report_answer: 单投票者节点在引导后配置条目位于日志索引 1，而 GetConfiguration 返回的 future 报告的索引为 0，Stats 的 latest_configuration_index 同样为 "0"，尽管它返回的配置确实是当前配置（仍包含本节点）。测试以退出码 0 结束，违规体现在被判定的索引比较上；该结论仅说明这一条配置实例，第二次配置变更与调用方的实际影响未被执行观测。
